name: Nemesis Operatives Expansion Pack
description: Example Nemesis Operatives from Kill Team: Nemesis Operatives (custom builder showcase profiles). Control is stored in the APL column. Ambull and Archivist mission packs are synced separately from KTDash. Sourced from the Nemesis Operatives dossier until KTDash publishes this pack.

operatives.name: Armoured Sentinel
operatives.abilities:
Control 5 (use APL column for control checks; operatives do not spend action points).

Behaviour: MARKSMAN — When activated, if this NPO can perform the Shoot action during that activation, give it an Engage order. If it cannot, give it a Conceal order.

1. Fall Back to cover. If possible, to a location where there is a valid target that is not obscured.
2. Shoot.
3. Reposition to cover. If possible, to a location where there is a valid target that is not obscured (a subsequent Dash action can fulfil this, if able).
4. Dash to cover. If possible, to a location where there is a valid target that is not obscured.

Defenders of the Imperium: Whenever an operative is shooting this NPO, if it is wholly within its territory, one of its defence dice can be retained as a normal success without rolling it.

Armored: This operative has the Extra Defence core rule (roll one additional defence dice unless injured).

Focused Targeting: Whenever this operative is shooting, weapons on its datacard have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.

Nemesis Operative: Bulky; can move through operatives (excluding other NEMESIS operatives); ignore APL changes; cannot be Conceal; cannot be in cover from Light terrain; can be shot while in melee; activates up to twice per turning point per mission pack rules.

operatives.name: XV8 Crisis Battlesuit
operatives.abilities:
Control 5 (use APL column for control checks).

Behaviour: BATTLER — When activated, if this NPO can perform the Shoot action during that activation, give it an Engage order. If it cannot, give it a Conceal order.

1. Shoot the closest player operative.
2. Reposition towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible.
3. Dash towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible.
4. Fight if the closest player operative is within control range.

Supporting Fire: Whenever another friendly T'au Empire NPO is within 3" of this operative, ranged weapons on this operative's datacard have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.

Nemesis Operative: Bulky; can move through operatives (excluding other NEMESIS operatives); ignore APL changes; cannot be Conceal; cannot be in cover from Light terrain; can be shot while in melee; activates up to twice per turning point per mission pack rules.

operatives.name: Screamer-Killer
operatives.abilities:
Control 6 (use APL column for control checks).

Behaviour: BRAWLER — When activated, if this NPO can perform the Fight or Charge action during that activation, give it an Engage order. If it cannot, give it a Conceal order.

1. Fight.
2. Charge the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.
3. Reposition towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible (a subsequent Dash action can fulfil this, if able).
4. Dash towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible.

The Will of the Hive Mind: Ignore changes to this operative's stats from being injured.

Nemesis Operative: Bulky; can move through operatives (excluding other NEMESIS operatives); ignore APL changes; cannot be Conceal; cannot be in cover from Light terrain; can be shot while in melee; activates up to twice per turning point per mission pack rules.
